# DokuWiki Direct MCP Server

A lightweight, **zero-dependency** MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that connects directly to a DokuWiki instance running the [MCP plugin](https://www.dokuwiki.org/plugin:mcp).

## Why?

The official approach uses [`mcp-remote`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mcp-remote) as a bridge between MCP clients (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, etc.) and the DokuWiki MCP plugin. However, `mcp-remote` breaks in environments with **self-signed SSL certificates** because:

- Node.js v22+ `fetch`/`undici` ignores `NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0` when passed as a shell environment variable
- The env var must be set **in-process** before any HTTP connections are made
- `mcp-remote` initializes its HTTP client before checking environment variables

This server solves the problem by:
- Setting TLS verification options **before** any `fetch` calls
- Calling the DokuWiki MCP endpoint **directly** via `fetch` (no intermediary)
- Using **zero external dependencies** — just Node.js built-ins
- Being ~140 lines of simple, auditable code

## Quick Start

### Claude Desktop

Add to your `claude_desktop_config.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "dokuwiki": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["C:/path/to/dokuwiki-mcp-server.mjs"],
      "env": {
        "DOKUWIKI_URL": "https://your-wiki.example.com/lib/plugins/mcp/mcp.php",
        "DOKUWIKI_TOKEN": "[REDACTED]",
        "DOKUWIKI_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY": "1"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### Claude Code

Add to your `~/.claude/settings.json` under `mcpServers`:

```json
{
  "dokuwiki": {
    "command": "node",
    "args": ["C:/path/to/dokuwiki-mcp-server.mjs"],
    "env": {
      "DOKUWIKI_URL": "https://your-wiki.example.com/lib/plugins/mcp/mcp.php",
      "DOKUWIKI_TOKEN": "[REDACTED]",
      "DOKUWIKI_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY": "1"
    }
  }
}
```

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `DOKUWIKI_URL` | Yes | Full URL to the MCP plugin endpoint |
| `DOKUWIKI_TOKEN` | Yes | JWT Bearer token (generated in DokuWiki Admin > MCP Plugin) |
| `DOKUWIKI_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY` | No | Set to `1` to skip TLS certificate verification (for self-signed certs) |

## Requirements

- **Node.js 18+** (uses built-in `fetch`)
- **DokuWiki** with the [MCP plugin](https://www.dokuwiki.org/plugin:mcp) installed and configured

## Available Tools

All tools from the DokuWiki MCP plugin are automatically proxied, including:

- `core_searchPages` — Full-text search
- `core_getPage` / `core_savePage` — Read/write wiki pages
- `core_listPages` — List pages in namespaces
- `core_getRecentPageChanges` — Recent changes
- `core_getPageInfo` / `core_getPageHistory` — Page metadata
- `plugin_aichat_ask` — AI Chat plugin queries
- And 50+ more methods from the DokuWiki Remote API

## How It Works

```
┌─────────────┐     stdio      ┌──────────────────┐     HTTPS/POST     ┌──────────┐
│ Claude Code │◄──(JSON-RPC)──►│ dokuwiki-mcp-    │◄──(JSON-RPC)──────►│ DokuWiki │
│ or Desktop  │                │ server.mjs       │                    │ MCP      │
└─────────────┘                └──────────────────┘                    │ Plugin   │
                                 • Zero dependencies                   └──────────┘
                                 • In-process TLS config
                                 • Tools list caching
```

The server acts as a thin stdio-to-HTTP bridge:
1. Receives JSON-RPC messages on stdin from the MCP client
2. Forwards them as HTTP POST requests to the DokuWiki MCP plugin
3. Returns the responses on stdout

## Troubleshooting

### "Cannot reach DokuWiki" on initialize

- Verify `DOKUWIKI_URL` is correct and the server is reachable
- If using a self-signed certificate, set `DOKUWIKI_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY=1`
- Check that the MCP plugin is installed: visit `https://your-wiki/lib/plugins/mcp/mcp.php` in a browser

### "HTTP 401" or "HTTP 403"

- Verify your JWT token is valid and not expired
- Regenerate the token in DokuWiki Admin > Configuration > MCP Plugin

### Tools not appearing

- Ensure the DokuWiki user associated with the token has appropriate permissions
- Check DokuWiki's ACL settings for the namespaces you want to access
